rows.en: What are you doing? Never let your guard down before an enemyyyy!
Keep a cool head!
Who's there? Whose voice is that?
Don't fall for his provocation!! Remember! That instant of Meikyo Shisui!
What is this voice... Whose voice is this, so full of warmth...?
What's the matter, God Gundam! If you think you can defeat me, then try it!
...That's right... I mustn't be misled... I have to calm my heart...
Haaaaaaaah...
Yes, that's it. Like a mirror without a single cloud...
...A heart like water, filled to the brim and perfectly still...
Yes... I remember now... This is the feeling...
Haaah...
...I see it! I can see it!! A single drop of water!!
Nuoh! Wh-what is this fighting spirit!?
This is nothing like what he showed before! Blast it! Insolent whelp!
Wh-what!? This is absurd!!
Elbow strike, backfist, straight punch... Toryaaaaaaah!!
No... Not me! How could I, Master Gundam, be rendered so helpless!? I won't stand for it!
Oryaaaaaaah!! Teyaaaaaaaah!!
Vanish!! Master Gundaaaaaaaaaam!!
I remember now... the heart of Meikyo Shisui...
I heard it... That voice helped me remember. That voice... could it be...!?
Hey! Aren't you done yet? How long are you gonna keep me waiting!?
Sorry to keep you.
So, is your training over?
...Yeah. My training is done, and it went well. Let's head back.
Obtained "Hyper Mode".
Completed the quest "State of Meikyo Shisui".
God Gundam must be in the party to progress this quest.
Masurao has sent word to 00. Take 00 with you to Veda Cube.
So you have come...!
First, allow me to thank you for accepting my challenge letter once again.
You're... Masurao!? Your form has changed!?
I made you a promise. A promise that I would cut you down without fail!!
And to fulfill that promise, I have been reborn...
Yes... as Susanowo!!
I have waited... I have waited for this! For this time! For the moment I face the Gundam!!
Now, Gundam!! This time, let us settle this once and for all!!
...You desire battle that much...
Of course!! It is destiny! That you and I must do battle!
...Understood. I accept your duel.
Well said!! Truly, you are my prima donna!!
That distortion... I will correct it with my own hands!
Then... have at you!!
00! Eliminating the target!
Susanowo! Fairly and squarely... we duel!!
Heh... It seems this is as far as I go...
I concede defeat... Gundam... Now! Deliver the finishing blow!!
I will not... finish you...
Wh... What are you saying!! You would show me mercy!?
Letting you live... That is my own kind of mercy stroke.
What... Absurd...!
Bushido... is found... in death... Bushido is...
You would turn your back on your enemy!!
Very well! Make your preparations! I shall wait!
Do you mean to insult me!? Bring 00 to me!!
Completed the quest "Duel with Masurao 2".
00 must be in the party to progress this quest.
I have been waiting.
Susanowo, what are you planning?
Gundam, I would have you answer my wish.
I have been waiting.
You... what are you planning?
Gundam, I would have you answer my wish.
What is it you want?
A duel in deadly earnest...
What!?
I, Susanowo, demand a duel with you!
You want to settle this that badly!?
Naturally! The ones who captivated my heart and shattered my warrior's spirit were none other than
you Gundams!
Indeed. It has surpassed love, transcended even hatred, and become destiny!
Destiny!?
Indeed! You and I are bound to do battle!
(I see... He is a being that we distorted...)
Understood. I accept your duel.
I ask for nothing less than your all!
Hey! You're really gonna fight him!?
There is no other way.
This is the path I desire... the path of the Asura!

notes.note: Speakers for DG_QUEST019 traced from Quest019.bla (MessWinSet +N -> row N+1, confirmed by content): Master Gundam (illusion) 0.36/41/49-54; mysterious voice (???) 0.37/39/44; God Gundam 0.38/40/42-48, 53-60, 62, 64; Ankh 0.61/63. 0.36 is Master Gundam taunting God Gundam while he is distracted by the voice.
Source reads tatareta (likely typo for tataeta, 'brimming'); rendered as water filled to the brim and still (meikyo shisui imagery).
te mo ashi mo dasenu (unable to lay a hand or foot on him) rendered 'rendered so helpless' to fit the box.
Not referenced in the traced script; content (asking whether training is over, between God Gundam lines) makes it Ankh.

Rows 0.1-0.39 are not referenced by Quest020.bla (it only calls +46..+79 -> rows 0.47-0.80). They look like an unused older version of the Susanowo duel ('Duel with Masurao 2'). Speakers inferred from content: Susanowo (Mr. Bushido) for archaic lines, 00 for terse ones. 0.1 is an old quest-description draft; the live title/description are QuestMess 0.21/0.71.
Source typo (umarekawatta da yo) read as umarekawatta no da yo.
Source 'Gundam wo shunkan wo' is garbled; read as the moment of facing the Gundam.
Source typo (ukesase morau) read as ukesasete morau: accepting the duel.
kaishaku = the second's mercy cut in seppuku; rendered 'my own kind of mercy stroke'.
Hagakure line ('the way of the samurai is found in death'); kept 'Bushido' for the Mr. Bushido resonance. The identical row in quest_051 (Table/Event/Quest/QuestEventMess020 copy) should reuse this.
Unused quest title (Masurao to no ikkiuchi 2) -> 'Duel with Masurao 2'; not in QuestMess.

Live event: script calls +46.. with ??? then 00 and Susanowo; mapping N+1. 0.41-0.43 duplicate 0.47-0.49 (0.42 names Susanowo, 0.48 says kisama). Susanowo (shown as ??? until he names himself) 0.41/43/47/49/51/53, 0.55-0.59/62/65; 00 0.42/48/50/52/54/58/60/61/64.
00's thought line; parentheses kept as in source.
Not referenced by the script; a rough-voiced party member (speaker unknown). Rendered speaker-neutral.
shura no michi -> 'path of the Asura' (Asura used for shura in CampMess/BaseMess).

report: 80/80 rows. DG_QUEST020 rows 0.1-0.39 unused by Quest020.bla (speakers inferred); QUEST019 0.63 Ankh by content; QUEST020 0.63 speaker unknown. Unused quest title 0.38 'Duel with Masurao 2' not in QuestMess. Source typos at QUEST019 0.45 and QUEST020 0.9/0.11/0.15.
